code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low oxygen saturation, low pO₂), suggestive of acute respiratory failure with metabolic/respiratory acidosis. There is mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia, which may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or infection. Mildly elevated ALT suggests possible liver involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
